retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy urban collage featuring a long-exposure cityscape background overlaid with massive, multi-layered block typography and playful hand-drawn doodles.
triggerTerms: heavy block text over night city
vibrant orange and blue urban design

recipe.visualDefinition: A dense, layered composition where a vibrant night-time city photograph is framed by oversized, high-contrast typography and whimsical, thick-outlined cartoon characters that interact with the text elements.
coreVisualRelationships: Massive black foreground text anchoring the lower half
Dynamic orange tilted text creating energy in the upper half
Playful white doodles weaving through the typographic layers
Vibrant blue-to-orange color gradient in the background photography
coreInvariants: Heavy white outlines on all primary text elements
Long-exposure light trails in the background image
High-contrast black, white, and orange color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The city skyline is the base; typography occupies 70% of the frame, with the largest word centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central, massive black block lettering with a thick white outline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left tilted orange text, moves down to the central black text, and ends at the white footer bar.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is intentionally crowded to convey 'party' energy.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blue and black for depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright orange for energy and focal points.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for outlines and legibility.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange and blue tones against high-value white and low-value black.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning resulting in overlapping outlines
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are often sheared or tilted to create a sense of motion
The 'I' in the central word is integrated with a vertical landmark silhouette
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a massive, static black base and a dynamic, tilted orange header.
graphicDevices: City landmark silhouette integrated into text

preserve: Tilted orientation of the top text
Integration of a vertical icon into the main word

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and geometric presence for the main anchor text.
Captures the playful, slightly irregular energy for the tilted header text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vibrant night-time cityscape photograph with long-exposure light trails on roads, featuring a prominent tower silhouette against a deep blue and orange sky.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add massive black block text with thick white outlines in the center. Add a secondary tilted orange text block in the top left. Overlay simple, thick-outlined white cartoon doodles (ghosts, hearts, clouds) that interact with the letters.

verificationChecks: Secondary text is orange and tilted
Background is a night city photo

adjustableVariables: Primary accent color (orange can be swapped for neon green or pink)
Tilt angle of the header text
mustRedesign: Specific artist names in the footer
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the white outlines don't blur into the background
Check that the doodles look hand-drawn and not like clip-art
Verify the city lights have a 'glow' effect
Confirm the hierarchy between the three main text levels
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a long-exposure urban photo + massive outlined sans-serif text + playful hand-drawn doodles + high-contrast orange/blue palette.
